Title: Add a Single Todo Item
Description: Verify user can add a todo item
Expected Result: A todo item labeled 'Buy milk' appears and is active

Title: Add Multiple Todo Items
Description: Verify multiple todos can be added and listed in order
Expected Result: All todos are displayed in entry order

Title: Prevent Adding Empty Todo
Description: Verify app does not allow empty todos

Title: Trim Leading and Trailing Spaces
Expected Result: Todo displays as 'Learn QA' without spaces

Title: Mark a Todo as Completed
Description: Verify a todo can be marked complete

Title: Uncheck a Completed Todo
Description: Verify a completed todo can be restored to active

Title: Edit an Existing Todo
Description: Verify user can edit todo text
Expected Result: Todo text updates after confirming edit

Title: Cancel Edit Without Saving
Description: Verify edits are not saved when cancelled

Title: Delete a Todo Item
Description: Verify user can delete a todo
Expected Result: Todo is removed from the list

Title: Toggle All to Complete
Description: Verify Toggle All completes all todos

Title: Toggle All to Active
Description: Verify Toggle All returns todos to active

Title: Filter to Show Only Active
Description: Verify Active filter hides completed todos

Title: Filter to Show Only Completed
Description: Verify Completed filter hides active todos

Title: Clear Completed Items
Description: Verify Clear Completed removes completed todos
Expected Result: All completed todos are deleted and active remain

Title: Todo Counter Updates Correctly
Description: Verify counter reflects active todo count
Expected Result: Counter updates based on number of active todos
